cohort_note: Highest and lowest seed production years during 2013–2018; no year labels assigned from the text alone. Rates are reported fractions of mature seed production, estimated from adjacent distinct sampling units, not individually linked seed histories.
caveats: Published density and fractions, not independent whole-forest observed intake counts.
Products are implied stage-loss density under original sampling/normalization, not directly counted flux or food biomass.
Vertebrate and rodent losses are distinct stages; do not interpret sum as total consumption by one animal group or add to cache benefit.
Two extreme years selected by published production extremes, not independent study replication or a causal model.
